notes: Vanilla Retribution at 60 has very few buttons: keep a seal up, Judgement it off on cooldown, autoattack, and swap to Hammer of Wrath in the execute window. The cited guide frames a two-tier rotation -- a plain 'Normal Rotation' and a higher-DPS 'Seal Twisting Rotation' -- and the fork's own retribution_paladin/apls/basic_ret.apl.json preset already has the twist worked out: swap to Seal of Command right before a melee swing lands if Seal of Righteousness is currently up, and swap back to Seal of Righteousness right before the next swing if Seal of Command is currently up, so the swing always benefits from whichever seal's on-hit effect the twist favors. That condition shape is ported directly here rather than re-derived. A plain 'keep Seal of Command up' line stays as the fallback for the rare case where neither seal is active (the swing timer has not fired since the last cast, or the first GCD of the fight), so the paladin is never seal-less. Hammer of Wrath (24239) is a rank the vanilla client never had at this level (rank 3, level 60) -- checked against this build's own spellconst, not remembered from live Classic.

expected_idle.reason: Exorcism only lands on Undead or Demon (sim/paladin/exorcism.go's ExtraCastCondition, target.MobType == Demon || Undead); the ladder's default encounter target is Humanoid, so this line's own gate structurally can never pass against it.

Hammer of Wrath is gated on core.Simulation.IsExecutePhase20(), the same duration-based execute-window flag warrior's Execute uses (sim/warrior/execute.go); the ladder's bare, no-consumes single-target run never casts it despite the window being wired correctly on the built request (execute_proportion_20 is nonzero and the duration-based transition lands in the fight's last quarter) -- reported to lane engine-melee as an open finding, not something this file's condition can fix.

priorityList.notes: Judgement on cooldown: it is a free global that unloads the seal's judgement effect and starts its ten second cooldown again.

Exorcism on cooldown vs Undead and Demons (paladin.md audit finding 3): implemented, learnable at 20, 15s cooldown, real Holy nuke -- sim/paladin/exorcism.go's ExtraCastCondition already gates it on target.MobType == Demon || Undead, and sim/core/spell.go routes ExtraCastCondition through Spell.CanCast, so spellCanCast naturally no-ops on any other target with no new APL condition type needed. Free damage on the right encounters; the smoke build's default target is not Undead or Demon, so this cannot be proven to fire against it -- proven structurally instead (the action survives the rank rewrite at 60 and 20, spellCanCast resolves with no validation warning).
Hammer of Wrath below 20 percent: the other button Retribution has besides seals and Judgement.
Reapply the primary seal once it is about to expire.
Seal twist: swap to Seal of Command right before a melee swing lands, if Seal of Righteousness is currently up.
Seal twist: swap back to Seal of Righteousness right before the next melee swing lands, if Seal of Command is currently up.
Fallback: if neither seal is active (the twist above has not fired yet), keep Seal of Command up so the paladin is never seal-less.
